item.title: Contract Clerk
item.job:description:
Responsibilities:
  • Input data, verify documents, ensure data accuracy and completeness
  • Administrative and operation support
  • Perform other duties as delegated and assigned by the management
 
Requirements:
  • Responsible, hard working, and willing to learn
  • Good command of both spoken and written English and Chinese
  • Proficient in computer applications including Lotus Notes, MS Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, etc.
  • Proficient in Chinese and English word processing

item.title: Senior Corporate Social Responsibility Manager / Corporate Social Responsibility Manager / Deputy Corporate Social Responsibility Manager
item.job:description:
Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate and participate in organizing CSR programs, community services or volunteer activities etc. 
  • Liaise with internal and external parties for launching the events / activities.
  • Perform ad hoc project(s) as assigned.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor degree holders or above.
  • 2 years' solid experience in organizing CSR programs, community services or volunteer activities will be an advantage.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills.
  • Good commend of both spoken and written English and Chinese. Fluent in Mandarin will be an advantage.   
  • Candidate with less experience will be considered as Assistant Corporate Social Responsibility Manager.

item.title: Customer Services Officer (Part-time)
item.description: Customer Services Officer delivers quality customer services through counter transactions.
item.job:description:
Responsibilities

  • Deliver quality customer services through counter transactions
  • Cross-sell retail banking products
  • Support back-end branch operations

Requirements

  • Secondary School graduate or above
  • Relevant teller experience an advantage
  • Strong sales and service  orientation with outgoing personality and good communication skills
  • Proficiency in English and Cantonese as well as fluency in Putonghua
  • Willing to perform shift duties and work no more than 17 hours per week

item.title: Operation Officer / Senior Officer / Contract (Warehouse)
item.job:description:
Responsibilities:：

  • Participate in the inspection of cash / precious metals
  • Assist daily warehouse operation, which include the transportation of items in and out of the warehouse, storage management etc
  • Perform other duties as delegated and assigned by the management

Requirements:

  • The experience in banking industry or vault management would be an advantage
  • Good risk management awareness and with Strong team spirit
  • Mature, self-motivated, able to work independently and under pressure
  • Strong risk awareness, organizational, analytical and communication skills
  • Good command of both verbal and written English and Chinese
  • Working location in Hong Kong Island (Eastern District)

item.title: Contract Assistant, Private Banking (Loan Operations)
item.job:description:
Responsibilities:

  • Handle credit documentation work, including but not limited to preparing credit documents (including Security Documents and Collateral Documents, etc.)
  • Handle legal procedures for credit facilities, verify loan preconditions and process system operations related to loan disbursement

Requirements: 

  • Higher Diploma Holder or above
  • Experience in handling loan disbursement documentation and system operation for private banking or corporate clients
  • Proficient in general computer applications (e.g. MS Word, Excel) and Chinese input methods
  • Proficient in written Chinese and English

item.title: Human Resources Manager (Talent Acquisition)
item.job:description:
Responsibilities:

  • Act as a recruitment manager focus on experienced hire of different business line
  • Provide a full range of recruitment support and administrative services including but not limited to arrangement of the posting of job advertisements, assessment and selection, participation in campus recruitment activities and other formalities
  • Handle any other ad hoc projects as assigned

Requirements:

  • Degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration or related disciplines
  • Minimum 3 years working experience in the area of recruitment support
  • Proficient in both spoken and written English and Chinese. Mandarin would be an advantage
  • Proficient in computer applications (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc)
  • Able to work under pressure and willing to work overtime when required
  • Immediate available is highly preferred

item.title: Customer Services Manager (Customer Services Centre)
item.description: The incumbent will be responsible for supervising the daily operation of customer service centre to provide quality and timely services to customers, either internal and external from different distribution channel. The incumbent is also expected to assist in various initiatives in alignment with Company’s strategic development for excellent customer experience and operational efficiency.
item.job:description:
Job Requirements:

  • Degree or above in relevant disciplines with professional insurance qualifications (FLMI, ACS)
  • 6 years or above working experience and preferably 3 years at supervisory level in life insurance with solid customer relationship management experience
  • Excellent customer-service mindset with effective interpersonal and communication skill
  • Patient, attentive to details with good problem solving and organizing skills
  • Positive, attentive to details and good organizing skills
  • Conversant with MS Word, Excel and Chinese Word Processing
  • Proficient in spoken & written English and Chinese
  • Preference will be given to candidates with good command of spoken Mandarin; proficiency in other Chinese dialects will be an asset

We offer 5-day work week, attractive remuneration package and excellent training & development opportunities. Interested parties please submit application through our company website: http://boclife.com.hk

(Data collected will be used for recruitment purpose only.)

item.title: Customer Service Officer (Campus Recruitment)
item.job:description:
Responsibilities

  • Handle daily counter transactions (including cash deposits/withdrawals, bill acceptance, transfers, time deposits, remittance services, etc.), customer enquiries and internal documentation at branches
  • Conduct product selling and client referral as required

Requirements

  • Bachelor degree or above
  • Customer-centric with strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Proficiency in English and Cantonese, fluency in Putonghua will be an advantage
